steps.description: Search for Peter Thiel's writings: Zero to One (book), Contrarian Thinking (essays/blogs/lectures), academic background (Stanford Law), CS183 lecture notes. Focus on monopoly theory, technology innovation, contrarian investing, PayPal/Palantir founding philosophy. Must include latest (2024-2026) publications/interviews.

Search for Peter Thiel interviews, keynote speeches, podcast appearances (Joe Rogan, Tim Ferriss, Conversations with Tyler), Stanford lectures, conference talks. Must include latest (2024-2026) interviews.
Analyze Peter Thiel's speaking/writing style, reasoning patterns, contrarian logic, how he explains complex technology and business concepts.
Search for how others view Peter Thiel (critiques, profiles, media coverage, Paypal Mafia lore, political views).
Research Peter Thiel's key decisions: co-founding PayPal, early Facebook investment, Palantir founding, Founders Fund, political activism, Gawker lawsuit, venture investments.
Build a comprehensive timeline of Peter Thiel's life, career, company milestones, and key investments.
Based on all references, write SKILL.md following Anthropic skill specification format. Include effect examples, expression DNA, mental models, decision heuristics, and investment cases.
Write _meta.json with metadata, tags, triggers, sources.

rules: Long documents must summarize core points + attach links
References 01-writings and 02-conversations are foundational — search thoroughly for latest materials
Wait for user confirmation after each step
